title: Repair Café Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Repair cafés are free.** Volunteers help you open and fix your own broken thing; a donation pays for tools and small parts.
**Most meet once or twice a month** on a fixed rhythm, like the **first Sunday** in Kreuzberg or the **third Monday** in Schöneberg. Check the café's page the day before.
**Monday evening is the busiest repair night:** Schöneberg, Brunnenviertel, Adlershof and Spandau Neustadt all meet on Mondays.
**Four tables need a booking:** Schöneberg and Steglitz by online form for the next date only, Friedrichshain and Mariendorf by time slot.
**Clothes:** Kreuzberg, Brunnenviertel, the wertstatt and Wedding. **Bikes:** Kreuzberg, Schöneberg, Schöneweide and the wertstatt.
**The ReparaturBONUS is closed** to new applications since **25 June 2025**. The 2026/2027 budget holds **1.25 million euros a year** for a new round, with no start date on 12 October 2026.
**My move:** take small electrics to the café on your line now; let a shop-sized repair wait for the bonus if it can.
